application_methods.young_plants: Apply in a circle 15-20cm from the trunk. Young plants need gentle feeding.
application_methods.growing_plants: Apply in a circle around the plant canopy edge (drip line).
application_methods.mature_plants: Broadcast evenly around the drip line extending 30-50cm outward. Mature trees benefit from broader application.
application_methods.avoid_trunk: Apply around the drip line, avoiding direct contact with the trunk.

watering.sandy_soil: Water deeply 2-3 times per week. Sandy soil drains quickly.
watering.clay_soil: Water deeply once per week. Clay retains moisture longer.
watering.default: Water deeply 1-2 times per week. Maintain consistent moisture.

mulching.template: Apply 5-7cm organic mulch around the base. This is especially important for {{soilType}} soil to regulate moisture and temperature.

monitoring.template_base: Check leaves weekly for improvement. Expected changes:

soil_testing.template_base: Given your {{soilType}} soil type, consider soil pH testing.
soil_testing.clay_note: Clay soils may have pH issues.
soil_testing.default_note: Regular testing ensures optimal nutrient availability.

fertilizer_notes.nitrogen: High nitrogen is essential for leaf growth and green color restoration.
fertilizer_notes.phosphorus: Phosphorus promotes root development and energy transfer.
fertilizer_notes.potassium: Potassium enhances disease resistance and overall plant health.
fertilizer_notes.iron: Iron deficiency causes yellowing of young leaves (chlorosis).
fertilizer_notes.magnesium: Magnesium is crucial for chlorophyll production.

soil_notes.clay: Clay soil retains nutrients well but may have drainage issues. Apply in smaller doses more frequently.
soil_notes.sandy: Sandy soil drains quickly and loses nutrients faster. Apply slightly higher doses with increased frequency.
soil_notes.loamy: Loamy soil has good nutrient retention and drainage. Standard application rates work well.
soil_notes.silty: Silty soil has medium drainage. Monitor moisture levels carefully.

notes.leaf_analyzing: Real-time ML analysis in progress. This will provide accurate fertilizer recommendations based on your leaf sample.
notes.soil_enhanced: Enhanced analysis with both leaf and soil samples for comprehensive recommendations.

soil_ph_testing.action: Test soil pH levels - cinnamon thrives in slightly acidic soil (pH 6.0-6.8)
soil_ph_testing.reason: Proper soil pH ensures optimal nutrient uptake during critical early growth

shade_management_seedling.action: Provide 70-80% shade using natural or artificial shade cloth
shade_management_seedling.reason: Seedlings are sensitive to direct sunlight and need gradual acclimatization

weed_control_seedling.action: Manually remove weeds around seedlings, maintain 1m weed-free circle
weed_control_seedling.reason: Weeds compete for nutrients and water that are crucial for seedling development

training_pruning.action: Prune lower branches up to 60cm height, maintain single leader stem
training_pruning.reason: Proper training creates strong trunk structure and improves bark quality

organic_mulching.action: Apply 5-7cm thick organic mulch around base, keep 15cm away from trunk
organic_mulching.reason: Mulch conserves moisture, controls temperature, and suppresses weed growth

support_staking.action: Install bamboo stakes for support, tie loosely with soft material
support_staking.reason: Young plants need support to develop straight trunks and resist wind damage

bark_quality_assessment.action: Inspect bark thickness and quality, check for optimal harvest timing
bark_quality_assessment.reason: Regular assessment ensures harvest at peak bark quality and oil content

canopy_management.action: Prune to maintain 3-4m height, remove dead/diseased branches
canopy_management.reason: Proper canopy management improves air circulation and bark accessibility

harvest_preparation_mature.action: Prepare harvesting tools, plan bark peeling schedule for optimal weather
harvest_preparation_mature.reason: Proper preparation ensures efficient harvest and maximum bark quality

weather_monitoring.action: Check weather conditions manually and monitor plant health
weather_monitoring.reason: Unable to fetch current weather data for location-based recommendations.

critical_irrigation.action: Water seedlings daily with 5-8L per plant. Check soil moisture 2cm deep.
critical_irrigation.reason: Young seedlings (under 6 months) are extremely vulnerable to water stress during root establishment.

drainage_management.action: Ensure proper drainage around seedlings to prevent waterlogging
drainage_management.reason: Waterlogged conditions can cause root rot in young cinnamon plants.

water_monitoring.action: Monitor soil moisture daily, water if top 2cm is dry
water_monitoring.reason: Consistent moisture is critical for seedling survival and growth.

heat_protection.action: Install 50-70% shade cloth, water early morning and evening
heat_protection.reason: Young seedlings cannot tolerate high temperatures - can cause permanent damage.

cold_protection.action: Protect seedlings with plastic covers during cold nights
cold_protection.reason: Cold stress can slow growth and weaken young cinnamon plants.

weed_control_stage1.action: Remove all weeds within 1m radius of each seedling
weed_control_stage1.reason: Weeds compete with young seedlings for nutrients and water, significantly affecting growth.

balanced_fertilization.action: Apply NPK fertilizer (2:1:1 ratio) - 150-200g per plant. Add organic compost monthly.
balanced_fertilization.reason: Plants at {{monthsOld}} months need regular nutrition for strong branch development and root expansion.

organic_nutrition.action: Apply well-decomposed compost and mulch around plants
organic_nutrition.trigger: Suboptimal soil conditions for chemical fertilizer application
organic_nutrition.reason: Organic matter improves soil structure and provides slow-release nutrients.

disease_prevention.action: Inspect leaves weekly for fungal spots, scale insects, and stem borers
disease_prevention.reason: High humidity creates favorable conditions for cinnamon leaf spot and other fungal diseases.

plant_health_check.action: Weekly inspection for pests, diseases, and nutrient deficiencies
plant_health_check.reason: Regular monitoring prevents major pest and disease outbreaks.

structural_pruning.action: Shape main stems, remove weak branches, promote 4-6 strong shoots
structural_pruning.trigger: Plants ready for structure development ({{monthsOld}} months old)
structural_pruning.reason: Proper structure now determines future harvest quality and quantity.

bark_harvesting.action: Harvest shoots 1.2-2.0cm diameter. Process bark within 6 hours.
bark_harvesting.trigger: Optimal harvest conditions: {{humidity}}% humidity, {{rainfall}}mm weekly rain
bark_harvesting.reason: Plants are {{yearsOld}} years old - perfect age for premium quality bark harvesting.

harvest_preparation_ready.action: Prepare harvesting tools and drying areas, monitor weather for optimal conditions
harvest_preparation_ready.trigger: Suboptimal harvest conditions - waiting for better weather
harvest_preparation_ready.reason: Harvest timing affects bark quality - wait for proper humidity and minimal rain.

pre_harvest_management.action: Continue regular care, prepare for harvesting in coming months
pre_harvest_management.trigger: Plants approaching harvest maturity ({{yearsOld}}.{{monthsRemaining}} years old)
pre_harvest_management.reason: Plants need continued care to ensure optimal bark development for future harvest.

post_harvest_processing.action: Ideal conditions for bark drying and curing - process any harvested bark
post_harvest_processing.reason: Low humidity prevents fungal growth during bark processing and ensures premium quality.

coppice_management.action: Monitor shoot regrowth, apply organic fertilizer to cut stumps
coppice_management.reason: Proper post-harvest care ensures strong regrowth for next harvest cycle in 18-24 months.

general_plant_care.action: Monitor plant health daily, maintain proper spacing and cleanliness around plants
general_plant_care.reason: Regular monitoring and maintenance is essential for healthy cinnamon cultivation at {{daysOld}} days old.

nutrient_deficiency_check.action: Capture clear images of the leaf and surrounding soil using the app. Ensure good lighting and no shadow distortion.
nutrient_deficiency_check.trigger: Seedling stage OR slow growth observed
nutrient_deficiency_check.reason: Young cinnamon plants require balanced nutrients for root establishment and early vigor.

disease_pest_scan.action: Scan affected leaves and stems using the camera. Upload multiple angles for accurate detection.
disease_pest_scan.trigger: After rainy week OR visible leaf spots
disease_pest_scan.reason: High moisture increases fungal infection risk in young plants.

weather_water_advisory.action: Check irrigation guidance based on current rainfall and temperature trends.
weather_water_advisory.reason: Proper water management prevents root stress.

growth_yield_projection.action: Upload recent stem images for automated stem counting and circumference analysis.
growth_yield_projection.reason: Shoot density and stem thickness directly influence future bark yield.

fertilizer_optimization.action: Capture leaf and soil images to detect nutrient deficiencies before fertilizer application.
fertilizer_optimization.trigger: Active growth period with adequate moisture

routine_pest_monitoring.action: Inspect leaves, stems, and soil for pests or early disease signs. Check for leaf discoloration, holes, or webbing.
routine_pest_monitoring.trigger: Regular weekly monitoring for nursery seedlings
routine_pest_monitoring.reason: Early detection of pests in young seedlings prevents major damage and ensures healthy establishment.

preventive_pest_monitoring.action: Perform a routine disease scan even if no visible symptoms.
preventive_pest_monitoring.trigger: After heavy rain OR humidity spike

crop_planning_advisory.action: Check recommended pruning timing based on predicted weather patterns.
crop_planning_advisory.reason: Proper pruning timing increases bark quality and regrowth rate.

harvest_readiness_assessment.action: Upload stem images for diameter and maturity verification.
harvest_readiness_assessment.reason: Harvesting at optimal stem thickness (1.5–2cm) ensures high-quality bark.

oil_yield_prediction.action: Enter farm data (age, stem count, previous yield, drying method).
oil_yield_prediction.reason: Predict expected oil yield and economic return before harvest.

distillation_optimization.action: Enter drying duration and distillation setup details.
distillation_optimization.reason: Optimizing drying time improves oil concentration and efficiency.

quality_monitoring.action: Generate yield performance report and compare with previous cycles.
